on Monday it priced a $3.75M registered direct offering, with gross proceeds before fees and expenses.
The offering includes 435,000 Class A ordinary shares and pre-funded warrants for up to 1.91M shares, each issued with Series A, B, and C warrants.
The combined purchase price is $1.60 per ordinary share package and $1.5999 per pre-funded warrant package.
Series A warrants are exercisable at $1.60 per share for five years, while Series B warrants are exercisable at $1.60 per unit for 60 days.
The offering is expected to close on or about October 20, 2026.
Maxim Group LLC is acting as the sole placement agent for the offering.

title: INLIF prices $3.75M registered direct offering
